description: A countable infinitary disjunction is true under an assignment exactly when at least one of its indexed disjuncts is true.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.realize_disj.{u, v, w, z} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w} [Finite α]
  {n : ℕ} {M : Type z} [L.Structure M] (φ : ℕ → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula L α n) (a : α → M)
  (b : Fin n → M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Realize (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula.disj φ) a
      b ↔
    ∃ i, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Realize (φ i) a b
